NEIGHBORHOOD TOOL LIBRARY — BORROWING DESK NOTICE
Posted: 2026-09-11

1. Record the tool identifier and checkout date on a borrowing slip.
2. A tool is due seven calendar days after checkout.
3. Write the due date on the slip and confirm it with the borrower.
4. Check a returned tool back in at the originating desk.

The notice does not specify reminder timing, cross-branch returns, renewals, or fees.
